content:
Context: 5. Final payment of accumulations in PF

Final payment of balance in cases of employees missing/ disappearing. When a subscriber is suddenly missing or disappearing and whose whereabouts are not known, the balance at credit of his GPF account can be paid to his family having regard to the nomination made by the employee  
subject to the following conditions:-  
- (1) The family must lodge a report with the Police Station concerned and obtain a report that the employee has not been traced after all efforts had been made by the Police.
